ops.oldText: governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction
ops.newText: governed exclusively by the laws of the State of New York, and the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York have exclusive jurisdiction

input.comment: [Playbook] We replaced Singapore law and exclusive Singapore venue with New York law and New York County courts, which is our accepted position and also removes the contradiction with Section 28.2. Delaware, California, or England and Wales law with the corresponding courts would also work if needed.
input.summary: Change governing law and venue from Singapore to New York, aligning with Section 28.2.
